# A history of firsts, all engineered to last.

## Improving efficiencies contributes dramatically to safer, smarter and more reliable operations.

We never stop working to be the premier trusted provider of the world’s most efficient steam
generation equipment, aftermarket parts, construction, maintenance and field services for power
generation and industrial applications.

From the initial patent in 1856 for the world’s first inherently safe water-tube boiler to diverse
technologies using the latest advanced steam cycles, our robust thermal energy solutions deliver
reliability, availability and long-term operation.

# A history of firsts, all engineered to last.

## Improving efficiencies contributes dramatically to safer, smarter and more reliable operations.

We never stop working to be the premier trusted provider of the world’s most efficient steam
generation equipment, aftermarket parts, construction, maintenance and field services for power
generation and industrial applications.

From the initial patent in 1856 for the world’s first inherently safe water-tube boiler to diverse
technologies using the latest advanced steam cycles, our robust thermal energy solutions deliver
reliability, availability and long-term operation.

## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,
from conceptual design, engineering, procurement and construction to the operations and maintenance
of facilities.

Clients, partners and communities trust Fluor because we are here for the long term – delivering
successful projects of both scale and significance for more than a century. From the spark of an
idea to a project's completion, our nearly 27,000 colleagues in more than 60 locations around the
globe provide professional and technical solutions with world-class expertise.

][35]

## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,
from conceptual design, engineering, procurement and construction to the operations and maintenance
of facilities.

Clients, partners and communities trust Fluor because we are here for the long term – delivering
successful projects of both scale and significance for more than a century. From the spark of an
idea to a project's completion, our nearly 27,000 colleagues in more than 60 locations around the
globe provide professional and technical solutions with world-class expertise.

# Welcome to Jacobs

# Moving what matters

From cities and corridors to ports and people, Jacobs delivers the infrastructure, innovation and
design that keeps the world moving. We do more than build transportation systems. We move people,
goods and communities — safely and efficiently.

## Challenging today. 
## Reinventing tomorrow.

Jacobs is a global professional services company delivering science-based, digitally enabled,
end-to-end solutions — from consulting and advisory to design and implementation — across the
world’s most complex infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, environmental and technology
challenges.

## Our expertise

Whatever your needs, our technical experts are here to help. We mobilise our rich heritage in core
markets, apply innovation and pursue excellence to solve today's challenges and equip you for
tomorrow's.

### 01 Buildings

Whether you’re in the public or private sector, we can support your project – we work across a broad
range of building types including arts and culture, aviation and ports, commercial, retail and
offices, education, healthcare, local and central government, residential and hotels, sports and
events venues, and transport buildings. 

[Our work in the Buildings market][135]

### 02 Defence and security

We are proud to be a trusted partner for some of the most complex and critical defence and security
equipment and infrastructure programmes worldwide, giving our clients what they need to be
operationally ready and effective. 

[Our work in the Defence and security market][136]

### 03 Energy

We understand energy markets and the different paces of transition. We’ll use our unique breadth of
energy sector technical expertise to co-create solutions with you, and help you deliver them.

[Our work in the Energy market][137]

### 04 Environment and society

Our global network of climate, environment and social experts support clients and project teams to
achieve: sustainability throughout the project lifecycle, a strong reputation with investors and
stakeholders, and innovative, cost-effective solutions.

[Our work in the Environment and society market][138]

### 05 Transport

Effective development and delivery of transport infrastructure is essential to realise the benefits
from efficient and sustainable transport networks. Leveraging our global expertise in urban,
suburban, and rural environments, our experts help clients create solutions that are intuitive and
safe to use – and that maximise wider social, health and environmental outcomes.  

[Our work in the Transport market][139]

### 06 Water

We have more than a century of water management experience and have played leading roles in many of
the world’s largest and most transformative water supply, wastewater, irrigation, drainage, and
flood protection projects. 

[Our work in the Water market][140]

## Our expertise

Whatever your needs, our technical experts are here to help. We mobilise our rich heritage in core
markets, apply innovation and pursue excellence to solve today's challenges and equip you for
tomorrow's.

### 01 Buildings

Whether you’re in the public or private sector, we can support your project – we work across a broad
range of building types including arts and culture, aviation and ports, commercial, retail and
offices, education, healthcare, local and central government, residential and hotels, sports and
events venues, and transport buildings. 

[Our work in the Buildings market][135]

### 02 Defence and security

We are proud to be a trusted partner for some of the most complex and critical defence and security
equipment and infrastructure programmes worldwide, giving our clients what they need to be
operationally ready and effective. 

[Our work in the Defence and security market][136]

### 03 Energy

We understand energy markets and the different paces of transition. We’ll use our unique breadth of
energy sector technical expertise to co-create solutions with you, and help you deliver them.

[Our work in the Energy market][137]

### 04 Environment and society

Our global network of climate, environment and social experts support clients and project teams to
achieve: sustainability throughout the project lifecycle, a strong reputation with investors and
stakeholders, and innovative, cost-effective solutions.

[Our work in the Environment and society market][138]

### 05 Transport

Effective development and delivery of transport infrastructure is essential to realise the benefits
from efficient and sustainable transport networks. Leveraging our global expertise in urban,
suburban, and rural environments, our experts help clients create solutions that are intuitive and
safe to use – and that maximise wider social, health and environmental outcomes.  

[Our work in the Transport market][139]

### 06 Water

We have more than a century of water management experience and have played leading roles in many of
the world’s largest and most transformative water supply, wastewater, irrigation, drainage, and
flood protection projects. 

[Our work in the Water market][140]

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,
both today and tomorrow.

# Natural Balance

### Addressing surging global energy demand and preserving a sustainable future will require a
### precise balance between renewable and nuclear energy.

[Learn Moreabout natural balance][14]

## Innovating
## Response

### The Natrium plant is a step forward for nuclear, providing an unprecedented ability to respond
### to power needs and balance the grid.

Our first Natrium plant is currently being built in Wyoming.

[Learn moreabout our plant][15]

###### Natrium

002
003

## Unique Symmetry

## The Natrium plant's unique construction and operational approach divides the facility into two
## independent islands.

###### ENERGY ISLAND

###### NUCLEAR ISLAND

## Optimized
## Process

### The Natrium reactor uses liquid metal to transfer heat from the reactor.

The properties of this material enable the system to operate at low pressure and cool naturally -
making it simpler and safer than any of today's plants.

###### Molten salt

004
005

## Stable Network

### While renewable energy is carbon-free, it is sometimes unavailable due to weather conditions.

Our innovative molten salt energy storage fills this energy gap, delivering stable electricity
supply for the grid when renewables are offline. Other designs do not have this flexibility.

## Clear
## Advantage

By moving to a much simpler plant design, the Natrium technology requires far fewer resources to
construct and operate. This results in lower costs and higher value.

Welcome to All Waste Services Incorporated (AWS). For over twenty years, our senior management has
focused our business activities on growth and opportunity for our customers, the community and our
employees as well as environmental protection.

At AWS, we have adopted a set of core values that are at the heart of the way we operate. We expect
our staff to always act in a safe manner, to act with integrity and respect for each other and our
clients and the local community.

We are service providers and we shall strive to provide our services in a manner which exceeds the
expectations of our customers.

We consider our employees to be our most valuable asset and we wish to develop and retain our people
through training and career path generation.

We wish to foster a belief in ourselves that we are confident in our ability to be the pre-eminent
integrated waste management company in the Philippines and we shall support our staff to achieve
this aim.

### New features, built for speed

Get paid faster with customizable dashboards, smart AI support, and built-in fraud prevention—all
powered by Visa’s payments ecosystem.

### Take, request, and find payments

[Demo for businesses][36]

[Demo for partners][37]

Offer flexible online payments with credit cards, debit cards, eChecks, and major digital wallets
like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for secure, convenient checkout.

## [The Story of Boltby Scar][97]

Boltby is a very important ancient site IMO. A gold “hair braid”, was found there, linking it to the
Amesbury Archer, buried with two similar hair braids. This also provides a link to the founding of
Stonehenge, which helps set a potential scene for a possible “zeitgeist”, of the day.

## [Swaledale][117]

Swaledale occupies the long, sinuous valley carved by the River Swale on its 45-kilometre descent
from Nine Standards Rigg (662 m) on the Pennine watershed to Richmond in lower Teesdale. The dale
narrows between rough gritstone scarps near Keld, broadens to a patchwork of hay-meadows around
Muker and Gunnerside, then opens into a tree-fringed flood-plain west of Reeth before the river cuts
through the Carboniferous escarpment to meet the Vale of Mowbray.

> Welcome to Brigantes Nation! The site that invites you to get involved in researching the
> Brigantes of Britain, Ireland and Spain.

The name Brigantia represents three separate concepts: a goddess, a people, and a tribal federation.
By the Roman period, the name represented a tribal federation compromising all of what would become
the Roman province of Britannia Secunda, except for the Parisi territory, east of the River Derwent.

Before the arrival of the Romans, West Yorkshire and much of the Pennine uplands were occupied by a
loose association of tribes known as the Brigantes. The name seems to mean ‘the high one’, which is
a suitable epithet for a group of people living in the more mountainous regions of Britain.

Historians know little about the Brigantes before the arrival of the Romans. Presumably their ruler
at the time was one of those who surrendered to Claudius at Colchester in AD 43, but they are not
mentioned by name. By the early 50s AD, they were being ruled by Queen Cartimandua. She lost her
control of the tribe in AD 69, following an uprising led by her ex-husband Venutius. The Romans put
down the rebellion and then went on to conquer the rest of northern Britain.

Brigantes Nation is a website for people interested in researching the Ancient Tribe of the
Brigantes based in Northern England.

> Brigantes of Britain, Ireland and Spain.

The name Brigantia represents three separate concepts: a goddess, a people, and a tribal federation.
By the Roman period, the name represented a tribal federation compromising all of what would become
the Roman province of Britannia Secunda, except for the Parisi territory, east of the River Derwent.

Before the arrival of the Romans, West Yorkshire and much of the Pennine uplands were occupied by a
loose association of tribes known as the Brigantes. The name seems to mean ‘the high one’, which is
a suitable epithet for a group of people living in the more mountainous regions of Britain.

Historians know little about the Brigantes before the arrival of the Romans. Presumably their ruler
at the time was one of those who surrendered to Claudius at Colchester in AD 43, but they are not
mentioned by name. By the early 50s AD, they were being ruled by Queen Cartimandua. She lost her
control of the tribe in AD 69, following an uprising led by her ex-husband Venutius. The Romans put
down the rebellion and then went on to conquer the rest of northern Britain.

Brigantes Nation is a website for people interested in researching the Ancient Tribe of the
Brigantes based in Northern England.

# Top Quality Fertility
# Care for 1/3 the Cost

CNY Fertility is the family-building partner you’ve been looking for.  A trusted team of fertility
specialists, a national network of clinics, a patient-friendly travel program, affordable pricing,
in-house payment plans, and 60,000+ lives changed forever. 

[ Family Building Guide][236] [ Schedule Consult][237]
+

## Our Mission in Action

We believe having a family is a basic human right so we’ve been making high-quality fertility care
accessible to everyone since 1997.
* ### Affordable
  
  We charge approximately 1/3 the national average for most major fertility treatments. We offer
  financing to EVERYONE. No credit checks, no problems.
* ### Access
  
  We believe everyone has the reproductive right to the fertility care they need. While many clinics
  restrict treatment options due to age, BMI, and FSH/AMH levels, we accept everyone. True success
  is found only in helping everyone.
* ### Quality
  
  Our providers have over 250 years of combined fertility experience, have helped create over 30,000
  lives, speak internationally on improving treatment outcomes, and lead a team dedicated to
  tailoring a treatment plan focused on YOU.

[ Success Stories ][238]

Trying to Conceive & Carry

## Fertility Treatments

Our fertility clinics offer the whole range of fertility treatments to ensure everyone has access to
the care they need. Whether it’s IUI, IVF, Donor Eggs, Egg Freezing, Reproductive Immunology, or any
number of other treatments, your care will be guided by a team of providers with over 250 years of
combined fertility care expertise and innovation.

# Top Quality Fertility
# Care for 1/3 the Cost

CNY Fertility is the family-building partner you’ve been looking for.  A trusted team of fertility
specialists, a national network of clinics, a patient-friendly travel program, affordable pricing,
in-house payment plans, and 60,000+ lives changed forever. 

[ Family Building Guide][236] [ Schedule Consult][237]
+

## Our Mission in Action

We believe having a family is a basic human right so we’ve been making high-quality fertility care
accessible to everyone since 1997.
* ### Affordable
  
  We charge approximately 1/3 the national average for most major fertility treatments. We offer
  financing to EVERYONE. No credit checks, no problems.
* ### Access
  
  We believe everyone has the reproductive right to the fertility care they need. While many clinics
  restrict treatment options due to age, BMI, and FSH/AMH levels, we accept everyone. True success
  is found only in helping everyone.
* ### Quality
  
  Our providers have over 250 years of combined fertility experience, have helped create over 30,000
  lives, speak internationally on improving treatment outcomes, and lead a team dedicated to
  tailoring a treatment plan focused on YOU.

[ Success Stories ][238]

Trying to Conceive & Carry

## Fertility Treatments

Our fertility clinics offer the whole range of fertility treatments to ensure everyone has access to
the care they need. Whether it’s IUI, IVF, Donor Eggs, Egg Freezing, Reproductive Immunology, or any
number of other treatments, your care will be guided by a team of providers with over 250 years of
combined fertility care expertise and innovation.

# Rooted In Excellence.
# Growing Above And Beyond.

At CooperSurgical, we’re rooted in a dedication to upholding the highest standards and reaching new
heights as a leader in the industry.

[Learn More][72]
[Rooted-in-excellence-tree]

### Healthcare Providers

CooperSurgical has been innovating in the fertility and women’s health field for nearly 35 years. As
leaders in the industry, we have pioneered new technologies that are changing the landscape of how
women, babies, and families are treated.

[Learn More][73]

### Patients

At CooperSurgical, we discover, engineer, and source highly effective products and services for
impactful solutions that truly make a difference in the lives of healthcare providers and their
patients.

[Learn More][74]

## About Us

We recognize every woman and family is unique and understand the wide range of health objectives
from contraception to fertility, as well as general and surgical gynecological care. Our deep
expertise and focus on fertility and women’s health has resulted in our specialized portfolio that
allows providers, women, and families to achieve their goals.

[Explore How][75]

## Get In Touch With Us

We’d love to hear from you. How can we help?

[Contact Us][76]

## Our Brands

From reproductive care to fertility, birth, and women’s health, CooperSurgical’s trusted family of
brands provides innovative solutions throughout your patient’s lifetime.

[Learn More][77]

what’s possible. We are a purpose-driven, dynamic team that cares about health, wellness, and making

# Achieve more together

We help life scientists with cryo-EM sample preparation to achieve more groundbreaking research
discoveries that will make a lasting difference in life

CryoSol-World (CryoSol) is an innovative high-tech company that aims to become the global leader in
sample preparation technology for cryo-EM. At CryoSol, we believe innovation in sample preparation
technology is of vital importance for structural biologists to advance their cryo-electron
microscopy (cryo-EM) results. This is why our focus is on controllable and reproducible solutions.
Our unique VitroJet solution helps structural biologists unravel the mysteries of proteins: the
molecules of life. Proteins play a key role in developing life-changing medicines, vaccines, and
cures for diseases, like COVID-19 and cancer. It will take a lot of research, knowledge-sharing and
hard work to get there. That is why we are driven to help structural biologists with their
challenges to vitrify samples and speed up their workflow with high-throughput. We are passionate
about science and we like to push the boundaries of technology. We are a flexible, open-minded team
that thrives on sharing knowledge. We value the contributions of customers, partners, and colleagues
around the world. Together, we can help life scientists in their quest to achieve more
groundbreaking research discoveries that will make a lasting difference in life. Because two achieve
more.

[Go to CryoSol-World][29]

## After 20 years of blotting and plunging, it’s time to change!

## Bring your cryo-EM sample preparation under control with the VitroJet

We have moved cryo-EM sample preparation into the new era of automation and high-throughput. After
numerous years of struggles with blotting and plunge freezing it was time for things to change! The
fully automated VitroJet, using pre-clipped grids, grants constant reproducibility of sample
preparation for both novices and specialists in structural biology research. The VitroJet allows
every scientist to control the process and to produce high quality samples. Having a highly
controllable and reproducible manner of sample preparation is a vital step for your team to advance
your cryo-EM research results. Ultimately the process brings a higher return on investment. It
allows you to use the imaging power of your cryo-electron microscope to its full potential. The
automated VitroJet takes you into the future.

[More about our VitroJet][30]

### A new era of cryo-EM
### sample preparation

## Explore the benefits of the VitroJet Solution

## Control and reproducibility of your samples for cryo-EM

The VitroJet is the most innovative solution today to vitrify your samples for cryo-EM: highly
controlled and reproducible. Its technology allows any scientist interested in structural biology to
take the next step when it comes to sample preparation.

Altogether, this makes the VitroJet the most innovative solution to vitrify your samples for cryo-EM
controlled and reproducible. Having a handle over your grid preparation enables scientists to reach
results faster. In this way unraveling the mysteries of proteins for the development of
life-changing medicines, vaccines, and cures for diseases.   

**Pre-clipped autogrids for sample optimization and flexibility**

**Automated workflows for user-independence and reduced training**

**Embedded plasma treatment for consistent grid wettability**

**Pin-printing for nanometer deposition precision**

**Jet vitrification for superior cooling rates**

**Visual feedback for sample layer validation**

[The VitroJet Technology][31]

## Unravel the mysteries of proteins

## Your sample of choice 

Scientists in structural biology research and drug discovery are performing cutting edge research
with high-end imaging equipment to unravel the yet unknown secrets of nature. With single particle
analysis using cryo-EM, structures and complexes of macromolecules can be resolved at near-atomic
resolution. With ongoing pressure to reduce the time-to-market of new drugs, the VitroJet is here to
contribute in speeding up structural biology research and discovery of new drugs. In your
application field, you want to prepare high quality samples to research the structures of soluble
proteins, membrane proteins, larger biological structures and small molecules and ligand binding.

Whether you are a structural biologist for your academic or pharma research the VitroJet helps you
to prepare your samples

institutes strive for controlled and reproducible sample preparation methods for cryo-EM innovative
research, avoiding the highly manual and laborious current preparation methods. We provide the
VitroJet solution to help you obtain reliable and reproducible results, in a high-throughput manner.
The samples are produced at high quality, of which prescreening on low-end microscopes is no longer
necessary due to the pre-screening process implemented in the VitroJet. Overall, this makes the
VitroJet a time and cost saving solution in the field of cryo-EM.

C-flat is the ideal holey carbon film for cryo-EM. And there are no long waiting periods — we make

Who We Are

## Biolyst Scientific Appoints New CEO to Lead Next Phase of Growth

[Biolyst Scientific][225] a leading provider of innovative solutions in the life sciences and
clinical laboratory markets, is pleased to announce the appointment of **Jay Hexamer** as its new
**Chief Executive Officer (CEO)**, effective immediately. This leadership transition reflects
Biolyst Scientific's continued focus on innovation and dedication to our customers.

**[Read the Press Release][226]**
Our Companies

## Visit All of Our Affiliate Websites

[Learn More][227]

Citifluor, A Division of Electron Microscopy Sciences, has developed a range of antifadent mounting
media which greatly reduce the fading of the fluorescence of fluorochromes or fluorescent dyes used
for labelling biological specimens.

A complete product catalog of the entire Diatome collection of Diamond knives, tools, and
accessories for Electron and Light microscopy for Biological and Materials Science at room and cryo
temperatures. Available on-line as well is information on our services, programs, specials, and
policies. The complete handling and use technical manual as well as troubleshooting can also be
found at our site.

Developed in 1875 by Arnold Dumont in La Sagne, Switzerland, Dumont produces high quality handmade
tweezers, and has gained the popularity of all researchers over the years. Only the highest quality
steel is used in the manufacturing of Dumont tweezers. See them online at www.DumontTweezers.com.

Workshops, One-on-One Training, and Equipment Demos - ranging from a general introduction to the
field of electron microscopy to very specific techniques. Located in Hatfield, PA, our Academy
houses several laboratories allowing students to get hands-on training in SEM, TEM and Wet Labs with
state-of-the-art equipment. Sign up today!

We are pleased to announce that we are the proud distributors of Ideal-tek tweezers and instruments.
Ideal-tek is committed to quality with the perfection of its products since being established in
Switzerland in 1964. Ideal-tek is one of the world's leading manufacturers of precision hand tools
and instruments. Take a look at the many varieties available.

Negafile furniture quality wood filing systems and storage cases for grids, negatives, film and
microscope glass slides. And a full line of shipping and packaging solutions for all your
traditional or digital media.

The NIGHTSEA® Stereo Microscope Fluorescence Adapter adapts just about any stereo microscope
(dissecting microscope) for fluorescence with no modification to the microscope itself. The modular
design lets you easily switch between several different excitation/emission combinations to work
with a variety of fluorescent proteins and other fluorophores.

The EMS Swiss Personal Line of Tweezers from Rubis merges precision engineering with ultra-modern
technology. Made in Switzerland exclusively for Electron Microscopy Sciences, these tweezers are
hand-selected by our experts for your specific requirements.

The Summers Optical on-line catalog, includes a complete line of optical cements, adhesives,
decementing agents, hardness testers, ultrasonic baths and UV lights, as well as technical and
transmission data and problem solving. Discover our unique bonding manual, including troubleshooting
and charts for choosing a cement for specific applications, and a complete set of MSDS on all of our
products.

Xite Fluorescence Flashlight System

Who We Are

## Biolyst Scientific Appoints New CEO to Lead Next Phase of Growth

[Biolyst Scientific][225] a leading provider of innovative solutions in the life sciences and
clinical laboratory markets, is pleased to announce the appointment of **Jay Hexamer** as its new
**Chief Executive Officer (CEO)**, effective immediately. This leadership transition reflects
Biolyst Scientific's continued focus on innovation and dedication to our customers.

**[Read the Press Release][226]**
Our Companies

## Visit All of Our Affiliate Websites

[Learn More][227]

Citifluor, A Division of Electron Microscopy Sciences, has developed a range of antifadent mounting
media which greatly reduce the fading of the fluorescence of fluorochromes or fluorescent dyes used
for labelling biological specimens.

A complete product catalog of the entire Diatome collection of Diamond knives, tools, and
accessories for Electron and Light microscopy for Biological and Materials Science at room and cryo
temperatures. Available on-line as well is information on our services, programs, specials, and
policies. The complete handling and use technical manual as well as troubleshooting can also be
found at our site.

Developed in 1875 by Arnold Dumont in La Sagne, Switzerland, Dumont produces high quality handmade
tweezers, and has gained the popularity of all researchers over the years. Only the highest quality
steel is used in the manufacturing of Dumont tweezers. See them online at www.DumontTweezers.com.

Workshops, One-on-One Training, and Equipment Demos - ranging from a general introduction to the
field of electron microscopy to very specific techniques. Located in Hatfield, PA, our Academy
houses several laboratories allowing students to get hands-on training in SEM, TEM and Wet Labs with
state-of-the-art equipment. Sign up today!

We are pleased to announce that we are the proud distributors of Ideal-tek tweezers and instruments.
Ideal-tek is committed to quality with the perfection of its products since being established in
Switzerland in 1964. Ideal-tek is one of the world's leading manufacturers of precision hand tools
and instruments. Take a look at the many varieties available.

Negafile furniture quality wood filing systems and storage cases for grids, negatives, film and
microscope glass slides. And a full line of shipping and packaging solutions for all your
traditional or digital media.

The NIGHTSEA® Stereo Microscope Fluorescence Adapter adapts just about any stereo microscope
(dissecting microscope) for fluorescence with no modification to the microscope itself. The modular
design lets you easily switch between several different excitation/emission combinations to work
with a variety of fluorescent proteins and other fluorophores.

The EMS Swiss Personal Line of Tweezers from Rubis merges precision engineering with ultra-modern
technology. Made in Switzerland exclusively for Electron Microscopy Sciences, these tweezers are
hand-selected by our experts for your specific requirements.

The Summers Optical on-line catalog, includes a complete line of optical cements, adhesives,
decementing agents, hardness testers, ultrasonic baths and UV lights, as well as technical and
transmission data and problem solving. Discover our unique bonding manual, including troubleshooting
and charts for choosing a cement for specific applications, and a complete set of MSDS on all of our
products.

### Cryotech: Feels like magic, but it’s actual science!

Dr Masashige Kuwayama created the novel Cryotec technique and product range for the vitrification
and heating of oocytes and embryos. It focuses on obtaining high cryopreservation survival rates and

Vit Plant Completes 20 Containers of Immobilized Waste

### Vit Plant Completes 20 Containers of Immobilized Waste

The Hanford Vit Plant has reached another major commissioning milestone, producing more than 20
stainless steel containers of immobilized low-activity waste.

[
Learn More
][78]
Hanford Site Begins Solidifying Tank Waste in Glass

### Hanford Site Begins Solidifying Tank Waste in Glass

The Hanford Site has successfully started up its Low-Activity Waste Facility, a key component of the
Hanford Vit Plant that has begun to solidify Hanford tank waste in glass for the first time.

[
Learn More
][79]
Vit Plant Transports First Vitrified Waste

### Vit Plant Transports First Vitrified Waste

For the first time, containers of low-activity vitrified (glass) waste were safely transported from
the Vit Plant to the Hanford Site’s Integrated Disposal Facility for safe, long-term storage.

[
Learn More
][80]

# Making History,

# Protecting the Future

### [Challenge: Processing Legacy Waste][81]

Safely process and immobilize 56 million gallons of radioactive waste stored in aging underground
storage tanks.

[Learn More][82]

### [Solution: Vitrification][83]

Deploying melter technology that will heat Hanford’s waste to 2,100 degrees Fahrenheit and turn it
into impermeable glass stored in stainless steel containers.

[Learn More][84]

### [Our Role: Protecting the Future][85]

3000 Vit Plant team members who are mission-focused, committed to safety and quality while
protecting the Hanford Site, Columbia River and surrounding communities.

[Learn More][86]

### About the Team

### [About DOE Hanford][99]

The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) manages the 580-square-mile Hanford Site cleanup through two
offices: Richland Operations and River Protection. Their mission is to safely and sustainably
address the environmental legacy of its historic plutonium production role. This includes overseeing
building and operating the world’s largest nuclear vitrification facilities to immobilize waste for
permanent disposal.

### About the Team

### [About DOE Hanford][99]

The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) manages the 580-square-mile Hanford Site cleanup through two
offices: Richland Operations and River Protection. Their mission is to safely and sustainably
address the environmental legacy of its historic plutonium production role. This includes overseeing
building and operating the world’s largest nuclear vitrification facilities to immobilize waste for
permanent disposal.

### [About Bechtel][100]

Bechtel National, Inc. (BNI) is charged with the design, construction, and start up of the Waste
Treatment Plant at the Site. This mammoth construction project is the largest of its kind in the
world. When complete, the Waste Treatment Plant will be used to transform the 56,000,000 gallons of
radioactive and chemical wastes being stored in underground tanks at Hanford into a stable glass
form for permanent disposal.

### [About Amentum][101]

Amentum-led Washington River Protection Solutions (WRPS) is bringing advanced technical solutions to
safely manage legacy liquid waste at the Hanford Site. This includes operation of tank farm
facilities including single-shell tank waste remediation and closure, and the design, construction,
and operation of waste receiving facilities and waste stream pretreatment capabilities for the Waste
Treatment Plant.

Vit Plant Completes 20 Containers of Immobilized Waste

### Vit Plant Completes 20 Containers of Immobilized Waste

The Hanford Vit Plant has reached another major commissioning milestone, producing more than 20
stainless steel containers of immobilized low-activity waste.

[
Learn More
][78]
Hanford Site Begins Solidifying Tank Waste in Glass

### Hanford Site Begins Solidifying Tank Waste in Glass

The Hanford Site has successfully started up its Low-Activity Waste Facility, a key component of the
Hanford Vit Plant that has begun to solidify Hanford tank waste in glass for the first time.

[
Learn More
][79]
Vit Plant Transports First Vitrified Waste

### Vit Plant Transports First Vitrified Waste

For the first time, containers of low-activity vitrified (glass) waste were safely transported from
the Vit Plant to the Hanford Site’s Integrated Disposal Facility for safe, long-term storage.

[
Learn More
][80]

# Making History,

# Protecting the Future

### [Challenge: Processing Legacy Waste][81]

Safely process and immobilize 56 million gallons of radioactive waste stored in aging underground
storage tanks.

[Learn More][82]

### [Solution: Vitrification][83]

Deploying melter technology that will heat Hanford’s waste to 2,100 degrees Fahrenheit and turn it
into impermeable glass stored in stainless steel containers.

[Learn More][84]

### [Our Role: Protecting the Future][85]

3000 Vit Plant team members who are mission-focused, committed to safety and quality while
protecting the Hanford Site, Columbia River and surrounding communities.

[Learn More][86]

Menopause is a stage of a woman's life that marks the ceasing of ovarian function after 12 months
without menstrual periods. It is a gradual process that typically happens in your 40s or 50s, and it
has a series of common symptoms like hot flashes, mood swings, vaginal dryness, cramps, dizziness,
etc. [Read more][84]

# Fulfill your dream of becoming a mother with IVI in Spain

Personalized assisted reproductive treatments with the best outcomes

[Make an appointment][168]

## Egg Donation Program in Spain

[Video]

Egg donation at IVI is performed in accordance with current EU legislation and follows the strict
medical protocols and standards established by the IVI Group. Our egg donation programme follows a
robust and strict traceability process.
Suitability, quality, safety and immediacy. Trust the most exclusive Egg Bank in the world, one that
treats its donors with great care

[ Why IVI? ][169]
[Video]

## Treatments

IVI is one of the European centres with the best pregnancy rates: 9 out of 10 couples who put their
trust in us achieve their objective.

### [ Artificial Insemination (AI) ][170]

[ Find out more ][171]

### [ In Vitro Fertilisation (IVF) ][172]

### [ IVF Genetic ][174]

### [ Highly complex reproduction ][180]

[ Find out more ][181]

1 de 3

#### Discover all the latest news

### [ Ovarian Rejuvenation ][182]

Rease the success of your treatment with your own eggs. We have the top specialists in fertility
treatments and state-of-the-art technology, all dedicated to increasing your chances of pregnancy
with your own eggs.

[ More info ][183]

### [ Highly complex reproduction ][184]

53% of our patients are 40 years old or over.
Many of our patients come to IVI with a difficult history, but thanks to our professionals,
continuous innovation and more than 30 years of experience, we can offer solutions to even the most
complex cases.

[ More info ][185]

### [ IVI Baby ][186]

We guarantee that your dream of becoming a mother will come true.
Refund of up to 100% of the price of the treatment if you don’t manage to have your baby.

[ More info ][187]

1 de 3

## Prices

[Video][Video]

IVI guarantees the final price of the treatment excluding diagnostic tests and complementary
techniques. All this together with personalised attention during the day-to-day treatment which
makes us the benchmarks in the sector.

# Nukleartechnik

## Wir setzen auf Kompetenz und Erfahrung

Wir sind spezialisiert auf Dienstleistungen, die den gesamten Lebenszyklus kerntechnischer Anlagen
umfassen.

Wir planen und entwerfen, liefern und installieren – auch schlüsselfertig – verfahrenstechnische
Geräte, Systeme und Anlagen in Kernkraftwerken und Forschungseinrichtungen im In- und Ausland. Wir
führen Wartungs- und Inspektionsarbeiten sowie Nachrüstungsmaßnahmen durch.

Wir decken die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette ab (vom Projektmanagement bis zu EPC-Projekten), indem
wir auf unserer langjährigen Präsenz in der deutschen Nuklearindustrie aufbauen, die mit dem Bau der
ersten KKW und unserem umfassenden Wissen über Kunden und Standortspezifikationen durch unsere
Präsenz vor Ort begann.

Unsere Kernkompetenz umfasst heute vor allem die Nachbetriebsphase, den Abbau kerntechnischer
Anlagen sowie die Planung und Lieferung von Anlagen zur Behandlung, Konditionierung und Entsorgung
radioaktiver Abfälle.

In großen europäischen Leuchtturm-Projekten wie CERN und ITER helfen unsere Ingenieure mit ihrer
Designarbeit dabei, Top-Forschungsideen in Lösungen im industriellen Maßstab umzusetzen.

Seit dem 1. Januar 2022 bündelt **[Bouygues Construction S.A.][15]** ihre vielfältigen Kompetenzen
im Bereich der Nukleardienstleistungen in der Division Bouygues Expertises Nucléaires und bietet
ihren Kunden damit ein hochmodernes, vollständig integriertes und innovatives Angebot mit hoher
Wertschöpfung, das den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Anlagen sowie alle Formen von technischem Know-how
in Frankreich, Deutschland und auf internationaler Ebene umfasst.

Auf dem deutschen Markt wird Bouygues Expertises Nucléaires durch die Kraftanlagen Heidelberg GmbH
und die Kraftanlagen Service GmbH vertreten.

#### Kraftanlagen Heidelberg GmbH

Wir bieten Dienstleistungen an, die den gesamten Lebenszyklus kerntechnischer Anlagen umfassen. Wir
planen, liefern und montieren schlüsselfertig verfahrenstechnische Anlagen und Systeme in
Kernkraftwerken und Forschungseinrichtungen im In- und Ausland.

[Erfahren Sie mehr][16]

#### **Kraftanlagen Service GmbH **

Als Partner, für Betreiber von kerntechnischen Anlagen und Kunden aus der kerntechnischen Branche,
zeichnen wir uns durch ein breites Dienstleistungsportfolio mit hoher Anpassungsfähigkeit an die
Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden aus. So beweisen wir unsere Kompetenz in den Bereichen Strahlenschutz,
Dekontamination, Rückbau und Montage jeden Tag.

[Erfahren Sie mehr][17]

## Rückbau

Zu den größten Herausforderungen der Energiewende zählt die Abschaltung der deutschen
Kernkraftwerke. Kraftanlagen Heidelberg bietet umfassende Lösungen für den Nachbetrieb, den Rückbau
und die Entsorgung kerntechnischer Anlagen an.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][18]

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][19]

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][20]

## Abfallmanagement

Seit vielen Jahren sind wir eines der führenden Unternehmen in der Planung, Lieferung, Montage und
im Betrieb von Reststoff- und Abfallbehandlungsanlagen.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][21]

## Montage, Service und Rohrleitungsbau

Wir planen, liefern und montieren verfahrens- und maschinentechnische Systeme in Kernkraftwerken,
kerntechnischen Anlagen und Forschungseinrichtungen im In- und Ausland. Wir führen Instandhaltungs-
und Revisionsarbeiten sowie Nachrüstmaßnahmen durch.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][22]

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][23]

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][24]

## Verglasung

Kraftanlagen Heidelberg kann auf mehr als 40 Jahre Erfahrung bei Planung, Errichtung und
Inbetriebnahme von Verglasungsanlagen für hochradioaktive flüssige Abfälle (HAWC) aus der
Wiederaufarbeitung von Brennelementen zurückblicken.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][25]

## Ingenieurdienstleistungen

Unsere langjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Auslegung von Systemen und Komponenten in
kerntechnischen Anlagen in Kombination mit unserer Expertise in Fragen von technischen
Festigkeitsproblemen und Strömungsanalysen machen uns zu einem ganzheitlichen Dienstleister auch in
Bezug auf Fragestellungen bei Stillsetzung, dauerhafter Außerbetriebnahme oder Rückbau einer Anlage.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][27]

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][28]

## Innovationen und Technologien

Innovationen von heute sind die Gegenwart von morgen: im Rahmen von Projekten und Kooperationen
erarbeiten unsere hochqualifizierten Wissenschaftler und Ingenieure Lösungen für nationale und
internationale Forschungszentren sowie Energieversorgungs-Unternehmen (EVU´s) in den
unterschiedlichsten wissenschaftlichen Diszip

# Nukleartechnik

## Wir setzen auf Kompetenz und Erfahrung

Wir sind spezialisiert auf Dienstleistungen, die den gesamten Lebenszyklus kerntechnischer Anlagen
umfassen.

Wir planen und entwerfen, liefern und installieren – auch schlüsselfertig – verfahrenstechnische
Geräte, Systeme und Anlagen in Kernkraftwerken und Forschungseinrichtungen im In- und Ausland. Wir
führen Wartungs- und Inspektionsarbeiten sowie Nachrüstungsmaßnahmen durch.

Wir decken die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette ab (vom Projektmanagement bis zu EPC-Projekten), indem
wir auf unserer langjährigen Präsenz in der deutschen Nuklearindustrie aufbauen, die mit dem Bau der
ersten KKW und unserem umfassenden Wissen über Kunden und Standortspezifikationen durch unsere
Präsenz vor Ort begann.

Unsere Kernkompetenz umfasst heute vor allem die Nachbetriebsphase, den Abbau kerntechnischer
Anlagen sowie die Planung und Lieferung von Anlagen zur Behandlung, Konditionierung und Entsorgung
radioaktiver Abfälle.

In großen europäischen Leuchtturm-Projekten wie CERN und ITER helfen unsere Ingenieure mit ihrer
Designarbeit dabei, Top-Forschungsideen in Lösungen im industriellen Maßstab umzusetzen.

Seit dem 1. Januar 2022 bündelt **[Bouygues Construction S.A.][15]** ihre vielfältigen Kompetenzen
im Bereich der Nukleardienstleistungen in der Division Bouygues Expertises Nucléaires und bietet
ihren Kunden damit ein hochmodernes, vollständig integriertes und innovatives Angebot mit hoher
Wertschöpfung, das den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Anlagen sowie alle Formen von technischem Know-how
in Frankreich, Deutschland und auf internationaler Ebene umfasst.

Auf dem deutschen Markt wird Bouygues Expertises Nucléaires durch die Kraftanlagen Heidelberg GmbH
und die Kraftanlagen Service GmbH vertreten.

#### Kraftanlagen Heidelberg GmbH

Wir bieten Dienstleistungen an, die den gesamten Lebenszyklus kerntechnischer Anlagen umfassen. Wir
planen, liefern und montieren schlüsselfertig verfahrenstechnische Anlagen und Systeme in
Kernkraftwerken und Forschungseinrichtungen im In- und Ausland.

[Erfahren Sie mehr][16]

#### **Kraftanlagen Service GmbH **

Als Partner, für Betreiber von kerntechnischen Anlagen und Kunden aus der kerntechnischen Branche,
zeichnen wir uns durch ein breites Dienstleistungsportfolio mit hoher Anpassungsfähigkeit an die
Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden aus. So beweisen wir unsere Kompetenz in den Bereichen Strahlenschutz,
Dekontamination, Rückbau und Montage jeden Tag.

[Erfahren Sie mehr][17]

## Rückbau

Zu den größten Herausforderungen der Energiewende zählt die Abschaltung der deutschen
Kernkraftwerke. Kraftanlagen Heidelberg bietet umfassende Lösungen für den Nachbetrieb, den Rückbau
und die Entsorgung kerntechnischer Anlagen an.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][18]

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][19]

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][20]

## Abfallmanagement

Seit vielen Jahren sind wir eines der führenden Unternehmen in der Planung, Lieferung, Montage und
im Betrieb von Reststoff- und Abfallbehandlungsanlagen.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][21]

## Montage, Service und Rohrleitungsbau

Wir planen, liefern und montieren verfahrens- und maschinentechnische Systeme in Kernkraftwerken,
kerntechnischen Anlagen und Forschungseinrichtungen im In- und Ausland. Wir führen Instandhaltungs-
und Revisionsarbeiten sowie Nachrüstmaßnahmen durch.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][22]

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][23]

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][24]

## Verglasung

Kraftanlagen Heidelberg kann auf mehr als 40 Jahre Erfahrung bei Planung, Errichtung und
Inbetriebnahme von Verglasungsanlagen für hochradioaktive flüssige Abfälle (HAWC) aus der
Wiederaufarbeitung von Brennelementen zurückblicken.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][25]

## Ingenieurdienstleistungen

Unsere langjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Auslegung von Systemen und Komponenten in
kerntechnischen Anlagen in Kombination mit unserer Expertise in Fragen von technischen
Festigkeitsproblemen und Strömungsanalysen machen uns zu einem ganzheitlichen Dienstleister auch in
Bezug auf Fragestellungen bei Stillsetzung, dauerhafter Außerbetriebnahme oder Rückbau einer Anlage.

##### [Erfahren Sie mehr ][27]

## Innovationen und Technologien

Innovationen von heute sind die Gegenwart von morgen: im Rahmen von Projekten und Kooperationen

internationale Forschungszentren sowie Energieversorgungs-Unternehmen (EVU´s) in den
unterschiedlichsten wissenschaftlichen Diszip

# A Journey Through Modern Physics

 

Welcome to the world of modern physics, a fascinating branch of science that guides us into the
deepest secrets of the universe and the fundamental laws of nature. From the discoveries of quantum
mechanics to Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity, modern physics continues to surprise us and
advance our understanding of the universe and the reality around us. By combining mathematics,
experiments, and incredible intuition, we explore the structure of matter, the universe, and time
itself. Join us on a journey of discovery and discover how modern physics moves us forward in our
exploration of the foundations of existence.

Modern Physics is a website dedicated to providing information about the latest discoveries,
theories, and research in the field of physics. It covers topics such as quantum mechanics,
relativity, electromagnetism, optics, and other key areas of modern physics. The goal of the site is
to share engaging articles, news, and educational materials that illuminate complex physics concepts
for the general public and open up discussion about how modern physics shapes our understanding of
the universe and the reality around us.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

### Mechanics

Enter a world of motion and force where we encounter the rules that govern the matter around us.
Mechanics allows us to understand how bodies move and what forces act on them, from planets orbiting
stars to the smallest particles in space.

### Thermodynamics

Immerse yourself in the hot world of energy and entropy, where thermodynamics rules the rules of
dispersion and balance. The study of heat and its transformations helps us understand how energy
spreads and changes in the form of heat and work.

### Electromagnetism

Uncover the secrets of electricity and magnetism that affect our daily lives. Electromagnetism
allows us to understand the interactions between charges and magnetic fields, which is fundamental
to the functioning of all electrical and electronic devices.

### Modern Physics

Enter the era of the latest discoveries and theories, where we meet quantum mechanics, the theory of
relativity and the search for a theory of everything. Modern physics opens the door to the unknown,
where our understanding of the universe and the fundamental laws of nature is constantly expanding
and changing.

### Applied Physics

Discover the frontier where physics propels technological innovation, from cutting-edge materials to
revolutionary electronic devices. It’s the science that transforms theoretical knowledge into
real-world applications, enhancing our everyday lives.

# A Journey Through Modern Physics

 

Welcome to the world of modern physics, a fascinating branch of science that guides us into the
deepest secrets of the universe and the fundamental laws of nature. From the discoveries of quantum
mechanics to Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity, modern physics continues to surprise us and
advance our understanding of the universe and the reality around us. By combining mathematics,
experiments, and incredible intuition, we explore the structure of matter, the universe, and time
itself. Join us on a journey of discovery and discover how modern physics moves us forward in our
exploration of the foundations of existence.

Modern Physics is a website dedicated to providing information about the latest discoveries,
theories, and research in the field of physics. It covers topics such as quantum mechanics,
relativity, electromagnetism, optics, and other key areas of modern physics. The goal of the site is
to share engaging articles, news, and educational materials that illuminate complex physics concepts
for the general public and open up discussion about how modern physics shapes our understanding of
the universe and the reality around us.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

### Mechanics

Enter a world of motion and force where we encounter the rules that govern the matter around us.
Mechanics allows us to understand how bodies move and what forces act on them, from planets orbiting
stars to the smallest particles in space.

### Thermodynamics

Immerse yourself in the hot world of energy and entropy, where thermodynamics rules the rules of
dispersion and balance. The study of heat and its transformations helps us understand how energy
spreads and changes in the form of heat and work.

### Electromagnetism

Uncover the secrets of electricity and magnetism that affect our daily lives. Electromagnetism
allows us to understand the interactions between charges and magnetic fields, which is fundamental
to the functioning of all electrical and electronic devices.

### Modern Physics

Enter the era of the latest discoveries and theories, where we meet quantum mechanics, the theory of
relativity and the search for a theory of everything. Modern physics opens the door to the unknown,
where our understanding of the universe and the fundamental laws of nature is constantly expanding
and changing.

### Applied Physics

Discover the frontier where physics propels technological innovation, from cutting-edge materials to
revolutionary electronic devices. It’s the science that transforms theoretical knowledge into
real-world applications, enhancing our everyday lives.

# NNL Capability Catalogue

NNL has over 750 personnel which maintain an unique capability ranging from fuel manufacture to
waste management and decommissioning. Our workforce represents a combined 10,000 years of expertise
in nuclear science and technology and we’re continuing to grow.

## Facilities, Skills and expertise which spans across the whole fuel cycle

We lead the world in nuclear innovation and are the only UK organisation able to provide technical
support across the whole nuclear industry.

### Fuels, Reactors and Reprocessing

The Fuel, Reactors & Reprocessing capability consists of three teams providing technical support
(commercial work, R&D, nuclear foresight & advice) to a wide range of customers including the UK
government.

Post Irradiation Examination

Materials and Corrosion

Reactor Design & Separation Science

### Nuclear Operations

The Nuclear Operations capability consists of 4 capabilities providing technical support (commercial
work, R&D, nuclear foresight & advice) to a wide range of customers including the UK government.

Modelling and Simulation

Measurement and Analysis

Plant Intervention

Safety, Security and Safeguards

### Waste Management and Decommissioning

WM&D carries out R&D and provides operational plant support services covering processing of
operational and historic wastes, management of liquid and aerial effluents, waste immobilisation of
LLW and higher activity wastes (cementation, vitrification), decommissioning, management of
radioactive contaminated land and both surface and geological disposal.

Waste & Residues Processing Services

Waste Packing & Disposal

Waste Behaviour & Characterisation

waste management and decommissioning. Our workforce represents a combined 10,000 years of expertise
in nuclear science and technology and we’re continuing to grow.

## Facilities, Skills and expertise which spans across the whole fuel cycle

We lead the world in nuclear innovation and are the only UK organisation able to provide technical
support across the whole nuclear industry.

### Fuels, Reactors and Reprocessing

The Fuel, Reactors & Reprocessing capability consists of three teams providing technical support
(commercial work, R&D, nuclear foresight & advice) to a wide range of customers including the UK
government.

Post Irradiation Examination

Materials and Corrosion

Reactor Design & Separation Science

### Nuclear Operations

The Nuclear Operations capability consists of 4 capabilities providing technical support (commercial
work, R&D, nuclear foresight & advice) to a wide range of customers including the UK government.

Modelling and Simulation

Measurement and Analysis

Plant Intervention

Safety, Security and Safeguards

### Waste Management and Decommissioning

WM&D carries out R&D and provides operational plant support services covering processing of
operational and historic wastes, management of liquid and aerial effluents, waste immobilisation of
LLW and higher activity wastes (cementation, vitrification), decommissioning, management of
radioactive contaminated land and both surface and geological disposal.

Waste & Residues Processing Services

Waste Packing & Disposal

Waste Behaviour & Characterisation

© 2026 Capability Catalogue.

# Professional ISO Medical Injection Molding Company

SeaskyMedical focuses on the development and production of medical injection molded products. We
assisting you in all stages, including product design and development, mold design and building,
material selection and injection molding.

[ Talk about Your Project ][141]

ISO 13485:2016 Certified

ISO 8 Cleanroom

Product Safety Oriented

[SeaskyMedical's ISO 8 Cleanroom 02]

## Your ISO Certificated Medical Molding Company

Seaskymedical is an ISO-certified **medical injection molding company** that manufactures injection
molded plastic devices that are used in the medical industry. We make use of certified raw materials
and carry out the production, assembly, and packaging processes in our ISO 8 cleanroom using
reliable injection molding machines. Afterwards, they are put through stringent inspection to ensure
that they meet the industry standards.

 

At Seaskymedical, we assist in providing you with excellent medical injection molding solutions for
a wide array of medical products.

[ More About Us ][143]
[green line]

plan a reasonable production process.

plastics for your products.

Adopting advanced injection molding technology, we bring you efficient solutions for manufacturing

][147]

## Our Molding Capabilities

As a professional injection molding company in the medical field, SeaskyMedical provides our
customers with comprehensive services and support.

In addition to being a certified medical injection molding company, we have in-house experts and
cutting-edge machines that improve the production of your medical injection molded products. Our
capabilities extend to all forms and stages of medical plastic molding manufacturing, including
product design and development, material selection, mold making, injection molding, and secondary
operations.

 

[ Unlock Our Capabilities ][148]
[Two staff members are discussing the program, with samples and drawings of injection molded
products on the table.]

## Problem-solver of Your Medical Injection Molding

SeaskyMedical has rich material knowledge and can deal with a wide range of medical-grade plastics.
Also, with our **ISO 13485:2016** certified cleanroom and micro injection molding capability, we can
meet the stringent cleanliness criteria and tight tolerance of the medical field.

[ More About Us ][149]

#### Cleanroom Injection Molding

The medical industry has extremely high requirements for product production. To minimize the
environment impact on products and improve product quality, it is very necessary to manufacture in a
dust-free workshop. SeaskyMedical invests  and establishs our own **ISO 8** cleanroom, which has
passed the **ISO 13485** certification.

[ More about Cleanroom Injection Molding > ][150]

#### Micro Injection Molding

The demand for micro-injection molding products in the medical field is growing rapidly.
SeaskyMedical addresses your needs with excellent micro injection molding capability. We have
imported medical micro injection equipment, specializing in the production of micro products ranging
from **0.1g to 0.5g**. As well as that, our product wall thickness can be as thin as **0.2mm**.

[ More about Micro Injection Molding > ][151]

#### Medical Insert Molding

Seaskymedical has extensive expertise with medical insert molding used in making a plastic
embodiment for metal and fragile medical devices that need better grip. With this, your hands will
maintain a perfect grip on them no matter the condition they are exposed to.

[ More about Medical Insert Molding > ][152]

#### Medical Overmolding

Overmolding, an injection molding process of coating equipment with several materials, is very
popular in the medical industry. For better rigidity and toughness of plastic medical devices, we
carry out overmolding processes. Your plastic medical devices will be more robust and there will be
no need for glue.

[ More about Medical Overmolding > ][153]

## One-Stop Medical Injection Molding Solution

Seaskymedical is an all-in-one medical molding company. We are capable of handling all your medical
plastic injection molding projects 

starting from the design & development all the way to the secondary operation, assembly, and
packaging.

Seaskymedical is highly-rated among the medical device injection molding companies for manufacturing

order of plastic medical molded products efficiently, and are able to meet the strict regulatory
guidelines that medical applications require.

# Professional ISO Medical Injection Molding Company

SeaskyMedical focuses on the development and production of medical injection molded products. We
assisting you in all stages, including product design and development, mold design and building,
material selection and injection molding.

## Your ISO Certificated Medical Molding Company

Seaskymedical is an ISO-certified **medical injection molding company** that manufactures injection
molded plastic devices that are used in the medical industry. We make use of certified raw materials
and carry out the production, assembly, and packaging processes in our ISO 8 cleanroom using
reliable injection molding machines. Afterwards, they are put through stringent inspection to ensure
that they meet the industry standards.

 

At Seaskymedical, we assist in providing you with excellent medical injection molding solutions for
a wide array of medical products.

[ More About Us ][143]

## Our Molding Capabilities

As a professional injection molding company in the medical field, SeaskyMedical provides our
customers with comprehensive services and support.

In addition to being a certified medical injection molding company, we have in-house experts and
cutting-edge machines that improve the production of your medical injection molded products. Our
capabilities extend to all forms and stages of medical plastic molding manufacturing, including
product design and development, material selection, mold making, injection molding, and secondary
operations.

 

[ Unlock Our Capabilities ][148]
[Two staff members are discussing the program, with samples and drawings of injection molded
products on the table.]

## Problem-solver of Your Medical Injection Molding

SeaskyMedical has rich material knowledge and can deal with a wide range of medical-grade plastics.
Also, with our **ISO 13485:2016** certified cleanroom and micro injection molding capability, we can
meet the stringent cleanliness criteria and tight tolerance of the medical field.

[ More About Us ][149]

#### Cleanroom Injection Molding

The medical industry has extremely high requirements for product production. To minimize the
environment impact on products and improve product quality, it is very necessary to manufacture in a
dust-free workshop. SeaskyMedical invests  and establishs our own **ISO 8** cleanroom, which has
passed the **ISO 13485** certification.

[ More about Cleanroom Injection Molding > ][150]

#### Micro Injection Molding

The demand for micro-injection molding products in the medical field is growing rapidly.
SeaskyMedical addresses your needs with excellent micro injection molding capability. We have
imported medical micro injection equipment, specializing in the production of micro products ranging
from **0.1g to 0.5g**. As well as that, our product wall thickness can be as thin as **0.2mm**.

[ More about Micro Injection Molding > ][151]

#### Medical Insert Molding

Seaskymedical has extensive expertise with medical insert molding used in making a plastic
embodiment for metal and fragile medical devices that need better grip. With this, your hands will
maintain a perfect grip on them no matter the condition they are exposed to.

[ More about Medical Insert Molding > ][152]

#### Medical Overmolding

Overmolding, an injection molding process of coating equipment with several materials, is very
popular in the medical industry. For better rigidity and toughness of plastic medical devices, we
carry out overmolding processes. Your plastic medical devices will be more robust and there will be
no need for glue.

[ More about Medical Overmolding > ][153]

Seaskymedical is an all-in-one medical molding company. We are capable of handling all your medical
plastic injection molding projects 

starting from the design & development all the way to the secondary operation, assembly, and
packaging.

* ## Co-creating IVF Success
  
  At Shivani Scientific, we enable and support IVF Centers and clinics to impart successful Assisted
  Reproductive Treatment by providing turnkey projects, innovative equipment, services and timely
  end to end solutions.
  
  [ Know More ][206]

**Our 50+ years of  Legacy - Leading the way in IVF Technology**

For half a century, **Shivani Scientific** has been at the forefront of providing innovative
technological solutions for **Life Science Laboratories** and the **Assisted Reproductive
Technology** (ART) industry. Our commitment to research and innovation ensures that you have access
to the latest IVF Lab equipment, tools and techniques that enhance the success rates of IVF
procedures. Shivani Scientific has been awarded as a Research Institute by the government of India
ministry of science and technology to conduct research in IVF field and on IVF incubators.

As a manufacturer and supplier of top-tier [**IVF Equipment**][207][ ][208]and [**IVF
Consumables**][209]and [**Media**][210], we offer best brands, as well as a leading [**IVF
Services**][211] and [**IVF Training**][212] provider, we bring a unique blend of expertise and
innovation to your IVF journey. [>>][213]

#### Know us through our activities…

**IVF Equipment
***Your Trusted Partner for Cutting-Edge IVF Equipment Solutions*

We are a one-stop solution for all your IVF needs. We provide a wide range of ART IVF lab equipment
for the complete IVF process, from IVF workstations and incubators to centrifuges, ICSI and lasers,
and equipment for oocyte retrieval.

[**Explore our diverse range of products**][214]

**IVF Consumables
***Need world-class IVF lab consumables and disposables? We have it all*

We offer a wide range of IVF lab consumables and disposables, from culture media to sperm counting
chambers, catheters, IVF culture dishes, microinjection pipettes & needles, ovum pickup needles,
embryo freezing kits, and more

**You are just a click away to check our entire range of IVF consumable **[**>>**][215]

**IVF Turnkey Project Management**
*We turn dreams into families: Your Complete IVF & IUI Lab Solution Experts.*

We offer a comprehensive turnkey solution for IVF and IUI lab setup, from design and build to IVF
Lab equipment and IVF Lab consumables. We provide a customized solution that meets your budget and
timeline.

Our team of experts has over 25 years of experience in the IVF industry. We are experts in IVF lab
design, and we only use the highest quality IVF Lab equipment and IVF Lab consumables. We also offer
world-class IVF & embryology training programs to ensure that your staff is up-to-date on the latest
techniques and procedures.

**If you are looking to set up an IVF or IUI lab, we are the right choice for you. **[**>>**][216]

**IVF Training
***Empowering Excellence in IVF: Your Path to Success Begins Here!*

We are proud to offer world-class IVF training programs that empower embryology professionals to
excel in their fields. Our IVF certification courses are designed to provide hands-on IVF training
for the needs of embryologists and IVF clinicians. We also offer hybrid IVF training that combines
in-person instruction with online learning.

Our training programs cover a wide range of topics, including Embryo selection and grading, Embryo
vitrification and thawing, Embryo assessment, Embryo transfer, Embryo culture media, Gamete quality,
Embryology Laboratory, IVF Lab air quality, and many others.

**Click to select the best course for you and your team **[**>>**][217]

**Let’s Co-Create IVF SUCCESS with Shivani Scientific's OPTITEMP PATENTED Technology!
***Pioneering IVF Excellence: Unleash the Power of Patented Temperature Control Method for IVF
Success!*

Overcome the challenges of inconsistent temperature control in IVF with Shivani Scientific's
patented temperature control method for IVF.

Our method has been granted a patent by the Indian Patent Office for its ability to ensure
consistent temperature for IVF embryos. This is a significant breakthrough, as even small
fluctuations in temperature can damage gametes and embryos and reduce their chances of survival.
**To learn more about Shivani Scientific's patented temperature control method, **[**click
here**][218]**.**

**A Legacy of Leadership & Innovation
***Shaping the Future of IVF Through Technology and Visionary Leadership.*

Shivani Scientific’s future vision is to invest in developing products and markets, broadening
product offerings, expansion of sales and focusing on improving competitiveness and profitability.

This can be accomplished by doing original research and using modern-day technologies such as
Virtual Reality, Artificial Intelligence, IoT, Machine Learning and Building Medical Device
Infrastructure, to name a few.

[**Click here to know more** >][219][>][220]

Scientific.

November 8, 2025, Vijayawada**

[**>>**][221]

October 7, 2025 Guwahati**

[**>>**][222]

  entire process so simple and straightforward that anyone can start an IVF clinic anywhere in
  India”*

## Tedavi Yöntemlerimiz

[

### Tüp Bebek Tedavisi (IVF)

Tüp bebek uygulamasında toplanan yumurtalar özel kültür ortamında yetiştirilir; sperm örnekleri
yumurtalarla buluşturularak döllenme sağl...

Detaylı Bilgi ][83] [

### Yumurta Donasyonu

Yumurta donasyonu; yumurta üretemeyen, ileri yaşta veya tekrarlayan IVF başarısızlığı yaşayan
kadınlar için yüksek başarılı bir seçenektir.

Detaylı Bilgi ][84] [

### Sperm Donasyonu

Sperm donasyonu, sperm kalitesi veya miktarı yetersiz olan çiftler, genetik hastalık taşıyıcılığı
bulunanlar ve tek ebeveyn adayları için...

Detaylı Bilgi ][85] [

### Embriyo Donasyonu

Embriyo donasyonu, hem yumurta hem sperm kaynağına ihtiyaç duyan çiftler için kapsamlı bir çözümdür.

Detaylı Bilgi ][86] [

### Preimplantasyon (Genetik Tanı)

Preimplantasyon genetik tanı (PGT), embriyo transferi öncesi genetik inceleme yapılmasını sağlar.

Detaylı Bilgi ][87] [

### Yumurta Dondurma

Yumurta dondurma (oosit vitrifikasyon), fertiliteyi korumak veya IVF döngüsünü ertelemek isteyen
kadınlar için güvenilir bir yöntemdir.

Detaylı Bilgi ][88] [

### Sperm ve Embriyo Dondurma

Sperm ve embriyo dondurma, tedavi döngüsünden kalan sağlıklı biyolojik materyalin ileride
kullanılmak üzere saklanmasını sağlar.

Detaylı Bilgi ][89] [

### Kadın Kısırlığı

Kıbrıs’ta kadınlarda kısırlık (infertilite) tedavisi, gebelik elde edemeyen kadınlarda sorunun
nedenini belirleyerek kişiye özel tedavi y...

Detaylı Bilgi ][90] [

### Erkek Kısırlığı

Kıbrıs’ta erkek infertilite (kısırlık) tedavisi, çocuk sahibi olamayan erkeklerde sorunun kaynağının
tespit edilerek en uygun tedavi yönt...

Detaylı Bilgi ][91] [

### Kısırlık Testleri

Kıbrıs’ta kısırlık testleri, çocuk sahibi olmak isteyen çiftlerin infertilite (kısırlık)
nedenlerinin doğru şekilde teşhis edilmesi için...

Detaylı Bilgi ][92] [

### Düşük Tedavileri

Kıbrıs’ta düşük (gebelik kaybı) yaşayan kadınlar için nedenlerin detaylı analizi ve tekrarlayan
kayıpların önlenmesine yönelik tedaviler...

Detaylı Bilgi ][93] [

### Doğurganlığı Artırma

Çocuk sahibi olmak isteyen çiftler için doğurganlığı artırmak hem doğal yollarla gebelik şansını
yükseltir hem de tüp bebek gibi yardımcı...

## VitriLife®

## Proven thermostabilization platform enabling ambient storage of vaccines and sensitive biologics.

Partners
Home
Problem

#### The Cold Chain is Broken

Maintaining temperature-sensitive vaccines and biologics is expensive, inefficient, and often
unreliable — especially in long-term storage and global distribution.
Spoilage, delays, and high costs overwhelm health systems and limit access in low-resource settings.


 

#### VitriLife® changes that.

Our patented thermostabilization platform eliminates the need for cold storage by transforming
sensitive biologicals into shelf-stable formats — without compromising potency or structure.


 

#### Why it matters:
* Reduces cold chain dependency and cost
* Enables ambient temperature storage and transport
* Preserves integrity of heat-labile vaccines and fragile biologics
* Scales globally — from pandemic response to routine immunization

Explore how VitriLife® unlocks global access to temperature-sensitive vaccines and biologics.

[Learn more ][7]

### Making Biologics Work in the Real World

VitriLife® delivers thermostable solutions for today’s most advanced drug products — eliminating
cold chain dependency and unlocking global access.

## Vaccines & Immunotherapies

[Vaccines & Meds icon]

Enable safe, stable delivery of prophylactic and therapeutic vaccines, mRNA constructs, and
monoclonal antibodies — without freezing or refrigeration.

Fragile Biologics & Cell-Free Systems

[Vial icon]

## Preserve the potency and integrity of heat-sensitive proteins, peptides, enzymes, and other
## biologics that are difficult to stabilize with traditional methods like lyophilization.

[Global Health & Field Deployment Icon]

### Global Health & Field Deployment

Deliver life-saving medications to remote and resource-limited settings with formats that withstand
ambient storage and transport, even in extreme climates.

[Formulation & Drug Development Icon]

## Formulation & Drug Development 

Accelerate formulation, clinical testing, and market readiness with a scalable platform that
simplifies stability challenges early in the development process.

[Get In Touch ][8]

### Our Partners

[NIH logo]
[CDC logo]
[DARPA logo]
[UTMB logo]
[BWH logo]
[University_of_Pittsburgh logo]
[Stemmedica logo]
[Native Microbials Logo]

### and more...

[Sunset illuminating the tall skyscrapers of San Diego in California from Centennial Park i]

## About us

Universal Stabilization Technologies, Inc. ("UST") is a San Diego-based provider of stabilization
and delivery enabling technologies with higher yields and at higher storage temperatures than
currently possible.  UST’s proprietary process enables the thermostabilization of vaccines and
biologics during long-term storage, transport, and distribution.  UST also develops novel mucosal
and transdermal delivery systems for vaccines and biologics.
